procedure: Created a fresh SQLite database and root contract in an isolated lab.
Started v4_daemon_runtime with daemon TTL 2 seconds and a live master session.
Confirmed the first daemon process was running, then terminated that process without graceful release.
Waited for the durable lease to expire.
Started a second daemon process against the same SQLite database with no fixed epoch.
Verified the second process acquired epoch 2 and completed a healthy bounded pass.
limitations: This is a local SQLite/daemon process recovery gate only.
It does not prove Master browser rebind, ChatGPT rate-limit popup acknowledgement, or production Task Scheduler registration.
The forced termination is process-level and does not simulate Windows power loss.
